summary: American Healthcare REIT filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, furnishing a Regulation FD press release and reporting under Item 8.01 that its board declared a regular quarterly cash distribution of $0.25 per share, an annualized rate of $1.00 per share, for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The record date is September 30, 2026, with payment on or about October 16, 2026, from legally available funds. This is a routine dividend declaration for the NYSE-listed healthcare REIT, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or strategic action are involved.
